description: Own the Admin-facing integration for event setup, advancing, readiness, run of show, day sheets, live tasks, incidents, show-day operations, and closeout.
exclusions: Canonical domain services and non-Admin product surfaces
Database migrations unless explicitly handed off by admin to database
Shared design-system primitives unless explicitly handed off by admin to design-system
Broad leases: app/admin/**, app/api/admin/**, components/admin/**, lib/admin/**, __tests__/admin/**
Post-launch paths unless the task outcome authorizes them
expansion_rule: Use these prefixes for discovery only. Active tasks must name exact implementation and test files; route any expansion through admin and record the reason in the task checkpoint.
